note: PG 89 has NO Calfa text, so this map was NOT built by the usual Calfa-token method. Columns were read off the plate's running heads (leaf 726 -> 1419, 727 -> 1421, 729 -> 1425) and per-leaf Greek/Latin parity was measured by Greek-character density in each x-half. PAIRING IS WITHIN A LEAF: each leaf carries one passage as Greek + its facing Latin, and the sides SWAP every leaf (727 Greek-left, 728 Latin-left, 729 Greek-left, 730 Latin-left). Confirmed on leaf 728 where Latin 'sacrae Scripturae capitula' faces Greek 'ta tes theias Graphes kephalaia'. Greek columns across the letter are therefore 1421(tail), 1424, 1425, 1428 - NOT a contiguous run. Formula verified only across leaves 726-731; do not extend it (leaf/page offset drifts within PG volumes).
citRange: PG 89, 1422-1427 (per DCO Rerum Conspectus; title block sits at the foot of the 1421|1422 opening, text runs to the 1427|1428 opening)
